Re-confirm identity decisions whose evidence changed

Source: R/identity_ledger.R
reconfirm_identity_decisions.Rd

For the decisions the last curate_iterate() run reported as identity_drift, appends a ledger line that keeps the decision and takes the current evidence fingerprint and snapshot. Use it only after reviewing each row against its current evidence. Stops, writing nothing, when the number of drifted decisions is not expected or a named row has not drifted.

Usage

reconfirm_identity_decisions(
  decisions_path,
  note,
  expected,
  recorded_by,
  rows = NULL,
  out_dir = dirname(decisions_path)
)

Arguments

decisions_path

Path to decisions.R.

note

Why the decisions still hold on the changed evidence.

expected

Number of decisions the caller means to re-confirm.

recorded_by

Who made the decision, for example "owner".

rows

Optional row_index values to restrict to. Default: every drifted decision.

out_dir

Output directory of the run. Defaults to the decisions file directory.

Value

Invisibly, the ledger path.
